overarching_objective: The student will be able to describe their daily study routine, discuss learning challenges, and verbally share advice on good study habits.
final_task: A guided role-play discussion where the student presents their ideal weekly study schedule and gives advice to the tutor, who plays a struggling student needing help with their learning habits.

lessons.objective: The student will be able to describe how often and when they study during the week.
lessons.topic: Talking about daily study routines and times.
lessons.lesson_task: The student verbally describes their current daily study routine to the tutor. The tutor asks follow-up questions about when the student takes breaks and reviews materials.

lessons.objective: The student will be able to describe their study environment and what makes it comfortable.
lessons.topic: Describing the physical space where learning happens.
lessons.lesson_task: The student verbally describes their study room or desk to the tutor. The tutor asks the student to explain how they keep the space organized.

lessons.objective: The student will be able to give simple instructions on how to take good notes during a lesson.
lessons.topic: How to take notes so you can review them later.
lessons.lesson_task: Role-play: The tutor acts as a new classmate asking how to take good notes in science class. The student gives verbal step-by-step instructions.

lessons.objective: The student will be able to talk about what they need to do to get ready for a test.
lessons.topic: Keeping your notes organized to prepare for exams.
lessons.lesson_task: The student tells the tutor exactly what they need to do to prepare for a big math exam next week. The tutor asks what subject is the hardest to pass.

lessons.objective: The student will be able to give advice on how to stay focused while studying.
lessons.topic: How phones stop you from being able to pay attention.
lessons.lesson_task: Role-play: The tutor complains they cannot focus on their homework because of their phone. The student gives verbal advice on avoiding distractions.

lessons.objective: The student will be able to politely ask a teacher or family member for help with schoolwork.
lessons.topic: What to do when a school subject is too difficult.
lessons.lesson_task: Role-play: The student pretends to be confused about a homework assignment and practices politely asking the tutor (acting as the teacher) to explain it again.

lessons.objective: The student will be able to ask questions about the meaning and spelling of new vocabulary.
lessons.topic: Better ways to learn words than just trying to memorize them.
lessons.lesson_task: The student and tutor verbally discuss the best ways to learn new English words. The tutor introduces 3 imaginary words, and the student must ask for their meaning, spelling, and how to pronounce them.

lessons.objective: The student will be able to express preferences about how they relax after studying.
functional_language: I like spending my free time...
lessons.topic: Making a schedule that includes fun and rest.
lessons.lesson_task: The student verbally plans a weekend schedule with the tutor, discussing how many hours they will be busy studying and how they prefer to relax in their free time.

lessons.objective: The student will be able to talk about their future plans for improving their grades.
lessons.topic: How goals help you focus on your studies.
lessons.lesson_task: The student verbally shares three learning goals for the current school term with the tutor and explains their plan to achieve them.

lessons.objective: The student will be able to present a complete study schedule and give advice on good learning habits.
lessons.topic: Creating a successful study routine to achieve your goal.
lessons.lesson_task: Final Task Simulation: The student verbally presents their ideal weekly study schedule. The tutor acts as a struggling student and asks for help. The tutor must prompt the student to recycle language from earlier lessons by asking questions like 'What about distractions?', 'How do I stay organized?', and 'How can I learn new English words?' The student must respond with advice.
